## Summary

Describe the user-visible change and any configuration/deployment implications.

## Validation

- [ ] Relevant tests/builds pass.
- [ ] Public, Submission, and Admin boundaries remain intact.
- [ ] Documentation is updated for changed behavior.
- [ ] No secrets, real attendee data, databases, or build output are included.
- [ ] Third-party notices are updated if dependencies/artwork changed.

Include migration/rollback notes for database changes. Do not paste credentials.
